Bounded merge review at ebea8dff79ec: combined compact Browser arrow/opening and full-height session picker with main mobile loading/error/retry, viewport sizing and immersive behavior. Preserved both shelf menu styling and fold-aware Inbox placement. Source conflict analysis identified two incoming Open selectors; changed only their accessible-name target to Open address so their existing failure and viewport assertions execute. Seven focused owners passed 120 tests; the complementary missing-Chromium guard was excluded because Chromium is installed. Four production-Browser renders with named read fixtures at 390/1440 light/dark were opened; after settling real CSS transitions, the arrow measured 44x44, the picker filled available height, and no horizontal overflow occurred. Existing shelf/fold browser geometry passed. Retained the guide arrow instruction with upstream local-server and narrow-pane sizing guidance. No new native, provider, physical-fold or release qualification is claimed.
